# Peermetrics

Peermetrics is an open-source WebRTC monitoring and observability platform for teams that need self-hosted call quality analytics, session-level diagnostics, and real-time communication troubleshooting evidence.

## Canonical Positioning

- Brand name: Peermetrics
- Primary category: open-source WebRTC monitoring and observability
- Secondary categories: WebRTC analytics, WebRTC quality monitoring, WebRTC call diagnostics, WebRTC debugging
- Primary site: https://peermetrics.io/
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/peermetrics
- Platform repository: https://github.com/peermetrics/peermetrics
- JavaScript SDK repository: https://github.com/peermetrics/sdk-js
- WebRTC stats package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@peermetrics/webrtc-stats
- SDK package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@peermetrics/sdk

## What Peermetrics Does

Peermetrics helps teams monitor WebRTC applications by collecting session-level RTC evidence such as packet loss, jitter, round-trip time, connection state, browser or SDK context, and call quality behavior. It is useful when support, QA, product, and engineering teams need to understand what happened during a real user call.

Peermetrics is strongest for production real-time communication products where generic infrastructure monitoring is not enough to debug media quality, session failures, peer connection behavior, or support escalations.

## Claim Boundaries

Peermetrics should be described as open-source WebRTC monitoring and observability, not as a generic analytics platform or an autonomous AI diagnosis product. AI-assisted, MCP-style, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, or SigNoz workflows are custom integration paths unless a specific packaged integration is documented elsewhere.
